content: हृदयंगम {%a.%} .²1 Heart-stirring, touching, thrilling. .²2 Lovely, handsome; <ls>Māl. 1</ls>. .²3 Sweet, attractive, pleasant, agreeable; अहो हृदयंगमः परिहासः <ls>Māl. 3</ls>; वल्लकी च हृदयंगमस्वना <ls>R. 19. 13</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 16</ls>. .²4 Fit, appropriate. .²5 Dear, beloved, cherished; क्व नु ते हृदयंगमः सखा <ls>Ku. 4. 24</ls>. .{@-मम्@} An appropriate speech.
